content.text:
I am the breath made meaningful, the vibration given purpose. I spill from mouths in rivers of intention—sometimes clear, sometimes muddied with doubt.

I am the pause before confession. The rush of argument. The stumble of nervousness and the smooth glide of rehearsed deception.

I carry love in whispered promises and hatred in shouted accusations. I am the same whether I announce war or sing lullabies. The tongue shapes me, but the heart decides what I become.

I disappear the moment I exist. You cannot hold me—only remember me, misremember me, quote me, misquote me. I am already gone.

I am what separates the lonely from the connected, the understood from the isolated. I am power when I persuade, weakness when I falter. I am the last words of the dying and the first cry of the born.

Listen—

Even silence defines itself against me.

I am never neutral. I am always *doing* something to you, to the air, to the space between us.

Speak me, and you commit an act.
